__MODE_GHVER_COMMENT__: 直连优先、失败回退系统代理，与 Get-LatestDshInfo 同策略
__MODE_START_FAILED_MSG__: 错误：找不到 Node.js 或 DSH 启动文件
__MODE_START_FAILED_BUBBLE__: DSH Web 启动失败：找不到 Node.js 或 DSH 启动文件。若未安装 Node.js 请先安装（https://nodejs.org）；若已安装，请用托盘「硬重启托盘」重新探测后重试。
__MODE_RESTART_BODY__:
$miRestart.Add_Click({
    try {
        # 重启 = 杀 web 服务 + 关闭 DSH 浏览器窗口 + 重启托盘本身（新托盘就绪后自动重开页面）
        $toKill = Get-DshListenerPid
        if ($toKill -gt 0) { & taskkill /PID $toKill /T /F 2>$null | Out-Null }
        # 关闭 DSH 浏览器窗口（按标题精准关闭，不碰其他标签页/窗口）
        try {
            Ensure-DshWinActivate
            [DshWinActivate]::CloseDshWindows()
        } catch {}
        # 独立 helper 进程接力（不能自己杀自己）：先杀旧托盘，再以 -OpenBrowser 重启托盘
        $trayPid   = $PID
        $trayScript = $PSCommandPath
        $helperPath = Join-Path $env:TEMP ("dsh-restart-" + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N') + '.ps1')
        # S6(第三轮实测, 正确形态): helper 内单引号字面量 + 运行时 '"'+raw+'"' 构造 CLI 参数
        $setupRawT = '__SETUP_PS1__'
        $setupEsc  = $setupRawT.Replace("'", "''")
        $trayEsc   = $trayScript.Replace("'", "''")
        $installEsc = $PSScriptRoot.Replace("'", "''")
        $helperEsc = $helperPath.Replace("'", "''")
        $helper = @"
Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
Stop-Process -Id $trayPid -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
`$setupRaw = '$setupEsc'
`$setupArg = '"' + `$setupRaw + '"'
`$trayRaw = '$trayEsc'
`$trayArg = '"' + `$trayRaw + '"'
`$installRaw = '$installEsc'
`$installArg = '"' + `$installRaw + '"'
Start-Process -FilePath 'powershell.exe' -ArgumentList '-NoProfile','-ExecutionPolicy','Bypass','-File',`$setupArg,'-InstallDir',`$installArg,'-NoShortcut' -Wait -WindowStyle Hidden
Start-Process -FilePath 'powershell.exe' -ArgumentList '-NoProfile','-ExecutionPolicy','Bypass','-WindowStyle','Hidden','-File',`$trayArg,'-OpenBrowser' -WindowStyle Hidden
Remove-Item -LiteralPath '$helperEsc' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
"@
        $u8r = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)
        [System.IO.File]::WriteAllBytes($helperPath, ([byte[]](0xEF,0xBB,0xBF)) + $u8r.GetBytes($helper))
        Start-Process -FilePath 'powershell.exe' -ArgumentList '-NoProfile','-ExecutionPolicy','Bypass','-WindowStyle','Hidden','-File',('"' + $helperPath + '"') -WindowStyle Hidden
        $notify.Visible = $false; $notify.Dispose()
        [System.Windows.Forms.Application]::Exit()
    } catch { }
})
__MODE_WEB_WATCHDOG_FAIL__: 自动重启失败：找不到 Node.js 或 DSH 启动文件。若 Node.js 未安装请先安装 https://nodejs.org；已安装则可用托盘「硬重启托盘」重新探测。
